# Entry-point-only Project

## Tech stack
- Python backend, React frontend

## Coding guidelines
- Follow PEP 8 for Python; use type hints on all public functions.
- Use functional components with hooks in React; no class components.

## Project structure
- `backend/` — FastAPI service
- `frontend/` — React app built with Vite

## Resources
- Run `make test` before committing.
- Run `make lint` to check formatting.
